summary: Void helper: if the string pointer a1 is non-null, measures its byte length with Strlen, allocates a buffer of length + 1 bytes via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc, and when that allocation succeeds invokes sub_58FCA0 (presumed copy routine). Nothing here stores the allocated pointer; the destination is implied to live inside sub_58FCA0. Called from NullTerminatedIntArrayCopyWithAlloc.

operations.description: Guard on a1 being non-null; the whole body is skipped when a1 is NULL.
Call Strlen(a1) to measure the byte length of the string; result held in v1.
Compute v1 + 1 to include room for the NUL terminator.
Call MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(v1 + 1) to allocate a buffer of string length plus terminator.
Guard on the malloc result being non-null before performing the copy step.
Call sub_58FCA0() when allocation succeeded; presumed string copy into the allocated buffer, destination unknown.
Invoked by NullTerminatedIntArrayCopyWithAlloc to allocate and copy a string produced during that copy operation.

unresolved: What sub_58FCA0 copies into and where it stores the allocated buffer is unknown; the malloc result is not kept by this function.
a1 is declared _DWORD* in the raw source but is passed to Strlen, which treats it as a character pointer.
Ownership and purpose of the allocation (caller-owned versus stored elsewhere by sub_58FCA0) is unresolved.
